description: This Java abstract class defines a registry for Event objects, providing mechanisms for parsing and resolving event types from JSON representations. It extends a generic JSON parsable registry and is marked as deprecated.

classes.name: AbstractEventRegistry
classes.description: An abstract generic registry class for Event objects that supports JSON parsing and type resolution, marked as deprecated.

methods.name: resolveType
methods.description: Resolves the event type from a JSON object by extracting the 'type' field; throws exception if missing.
